Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>

response.content:
I researched the Claude model family using the provided search results, which all come from Anthropic's own documentation. I also attempted to find official documentation for the GPT model family.

**Claude Context Window and Output Token Limits**

The official documentation from Anthropic establishes the context window sizes for different generations of their models. For the newest models, the context window has been expanded significantly, while older or faster models retain a smaller window.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Mythos Preview have a 1M-token context window." | CLAIM: A specific list of current Claude models have a 1 million token context window.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "A single request to any of them can generate up to 128k output tokens (`max_tokens`)." | CLAIM: For models with a 1M-token context window, the maximum output generation limit per request is 128,000 tokens.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Other Claude models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200k-token context window." | CLAIM: Models not listed in the 1M-token tier, such as Claude Sonnet 4.5, have a 200,000 token context window.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models | QUOTE: "Context window: 1M tokens is roughly 555k words or 2.5M Unicode characters on the current tokenizer (introduced with Claude Opus 4.7); models before it fit about 750k words in 1M tokens. 200k tokens is roughly 150k words." | CLAIM: The documentation defines the practical size of the context windows in terms of words and characters for both the 1M and 200k token tiers.

The model overview pages provide specific context and output limits for individual current models, including Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Haiku 4.5.

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/overview | QUOTE: "Context window: 1M tokens · Max output: 128K tokens" | CLAIM: Claude Opus 5.5 has a 1 million token context window and a 128,000 token maximum output limit.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/overview | QUOTE: "On the Message Batches API, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 support up to 300k output tokens with the `output-300k-2026-03-24` beta header." | CLAIM: Specific current Claude models can generate up to 300,000 output tokens on the Message Batches API when using a beta header.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models | QUOTE: "| Context window | 1M tokens | 1M tokens | 1M tokens | 200K tokens |" | CLAIM: The models overview table confirms Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5, and Claude Sonnet 5 have 1M token context windows, while Claude Haiku 4.5 has a 200K token context window.
SOURCE: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/models | QUOTE: "| Max output | 128K tokens | 128K tokens | 128K tokens | 64K tokens |" | CLAIM: The models overview table confirms Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5, and Claude Sonnet 5 have a 128K token maximum output, while Claude Haiku 4.5 has a 64K token maximum output.

The support center documentation reiterates the context window limits in a simplified format.

SOURCE: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8606395-how-large-is-the-claude-api-s-context-window | QUOTE: "The Claude API can ingest 1M tokens when using Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 5, or Sonnet 4.6, and 200K+ tokens (about 500 pages of text or more) when using all other models." | CLAIM: The support center confirms the 1M token context window for specific recent models and 200K+ tokens for others.

**GPT Context Window and Output Token Limits**

The web search results provided did not contain any documentation from OpenAI regarding GPT models.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Official documentation pages from OpenAI detailing the context window and output token limits for the current GPT model family.
